scientific_rationale: The parent program S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY runs the implemented pointwise operator with assignment_element_cost=0.0, so its local Hungarian correspondence is purely geometric and can match a generated local point to a teacher point of a different element identity. The implemented evaluate() subtracts p['assignment_element_cost']*probabilities[b,ids][:,self.labels] from the squared-distance cost before linear_sum_assignment, so raising this coefficient changes which teacher point each generated local point is pulled toward. This is a correspondence-mechanism hypothesis: the cost is detached (computed under torch.no_grad() from detached logits) and enters only the assignment, not the differentiable value, so it adds no direct elemental force and no affinity-head or categorical-logit gradient. It is distinct from the region-only and operator-only families in campaign/experiment_families, all of which left assignment_element_cost at 0.0.
